versions.subject: rule: RDP to 80/tcp or 443/tcp
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    Initiated: 'true'
    SourcePort: 3389
    TargetPort:
        - 80
        - 443
condition: selection
